title: backlog.py check refuses a leak-scan hit in an item's text
goal: backlog.py check runs the leak scan (kbcommon.leak_hits with _tools/tests_allowlist.txt) over each item's text (title, goal, repro, notes, gate questions and answers) and fails on a hit, so a bug filed with a quoted id or address is refused before commit instead of entering history for good; in SP-v5xagbyv a bug goal quoting two synthetic test ids blocked every publish until BG-md3ir277 relaxed publish
notes: backlog.py never calls kbcommon.leak_hits, so an item's text is not scanned before commit.
